findings.reason: Live bespoke Rust human-identity substrate (oya-identity). Higher ADRs cite it as depends_on/related authority (0507, 0509, 0536, 0537, 0553, 0559, 0564); none list it in supersedes. ADR-0632 Accepted amends 0478/0479/0480/0481 but not 0476 (OIDC/OAuth surface distinct from product-protocol amends). ADR-0562 relocates identity into iam/ capability tree without superseding the bespoke-IdP decision. ADR-0509 (layout clause referenced in body) is Superseded by 0512 and never frontmatter-amended 0476. Body path microservices/ and Connect-RPC mentions are layout/carrier drift only; task forbids body rewrite; no high-confidence frontmatter supersession/amend edge to add.

Live bespoke Rust billing engine (oya-billing). No higher ADR lists supersedes: ADR-0478. ADR-0632 Accepted amends ADR-0478 and frontmatter already has amended_by: [ADR-0632]. ADR-0509 related-only and itself Superseded by 0512. Core AGPL-avoidance + Rust billing decision remains north-star aligned; layout path prose not frontmatter-actionable.

Live bespoke Rust usage metering (oya-meter). No higher ADR lists supersedes: ADR-0479. ADR-0632 Accepted amends ADR-0479 and frontmatter already has amended_by: [ADR-0632]. ADR-0509 related-only and itself Superseded by 0512. Metering absorbed under billing/ capability in 0562 without superseding the bespoke-meter decision.
